semantics.state: Three one-bit flip-flop outputs A (XOR), B (AND), C (OR)
semantics.initialization: A=B=C=0 before machine begins, as explicitly assumed in original problem; implement initial values without adding reset port
semantics.clock: All three flip-flops update simultaneously on positive edge of clk using previous state
semantics.output: z = NOR(A,B,C), combinational from current flip-flop outputs; initially z=1
semantics.between_edges: Changing x does not change state or z

numeric.widths: All ports and all state bits one bit
numeric.operators: bitwise XOR, AND, OR, complement and NOR

verification.oracle: Independent three-bit state transition truth table derived from original gate connections
verification.sampling: Check initialized output after settling; before rising edge; after rising edge and nonblocking updates; after falling edge and input changes
verification.cases: Both input values from every reachable state, all 8-bit input sequences, extended constant runs and alternating input
verification.failure: Use case inequality and fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only after all checks
